description.value: Platform 7 Coffee is a specialty café in East Vancouver styled after a Victorian London train station, offering an extensive espresso bar, a full manual brew bar using Stumptown Coffee Roasters on a La Marzocco Strada, and a local artisan ice cream bar. The menu spans house-made sandwiches, wraps, baked goods, cold brew, nitro, and a broad tea bar—substantial enough to fuel a longer ride. A second location operates in Kitsilano at Broadway and Vine.

address.value: 2331 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5L 1V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the East Vancouver location at 2331 E Hastings St with phone (604) 428-1455, matching the OSM record. The menu page documents sandwiches, baked goods, an ice cream bar, and a full espresso/brew bar; the FAQ confirms local pickup is available ('Can I just pick it up locally from Platform 7? Absol[utely]'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null. A significant concern is the OSM 'community' field listing 'North Vancouver' when the address is clearly in East Vancouver, City of Vancouver.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is tagged as 'North Vancouver' but the address (2331 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5L 1V6) is in East Vancouver, City of Vancouver — likely a tagging error in OSM.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active specialty café on the Hastings Street corridor with a substantial food menu and confirmed local pickup—a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver.
